firstMessage.rawMarkdown: Our study asks whether the graph distance from what an issue names to where the fix lands predicts where a Gemma 4 E4B agent fails inside the official harness, and what the async omission in the provided graphs costs it. The plan was frozen on 16 Oct 2026, before any seeded runs. SHA-256 of the frozen plan: 0f30ff62f9d203aa1c39ef9adf12f2569fc08f5bce8dadf3fad2606068879baa. Public commitment: https://gist.github.com/woadi-vector/edc54ab68959e45c91e7f0582349be67. The full text will be released with the writeup.
